requirements.description: The system shall support product discovery through popularity-ranked browsing, category browsing, and access to product detail pages for guests and registered users.

The system shall allow logged-in users to create orders, modify remarks before delivery or completion, confirm received but incomplete orders, and cancel orders before delivery, validating input and persisting order records and status changes.
The system shall provide a personal center where logged-in users can view their favorited products and their own order history.
The system shall provide administrator-only product management for overall product status viewing, product detail inspection, search, modification, and deletion.
The system shall provide administrator-only order management, including list, detail, and modification operations for orders.
The system shall provide administrator-only user management, including list, detail, and modification operations for users.
The system shall record administrator backend management operations and support retrieving the operation logs using multiple search conditions.
The system shall authenticate users and enforce permissions that distinguish guests, registered users, and administrators, with registered users participating as customers or sellers.
The system shall distinguish human and automated activity, identify malicious behavior, validate input parameters on the server side, and provide protection against SQL injection.
The system shall protect user privacy and personalized information and ensure data stored in the database is reviewed before or during persistence, with unauthorized access blocked.

The system shall respond within 1.5 seconds during normal periods and within 4 seconds during peak periods in at least 95% of cases, and shall return off-peak searches by specific number or name within 3 seconds.
The system shall detect invalid input, keep unaffected modules available when a module fails, and support service restart, rollback, and emergency updates for fault recovery.
The system shall collect runtime metrics and logs for fault localization, covering server resources, service response times, request rates, error codes, database activity, middleware, and storage.
The system shall maintain decoupled module boundaries and provide extension points for future upgrades.

The system shall provide a coherent and discoverable user interaction structure, including a unified visual style, easy-to-find function entry points, and help or navigation mechanisms that support user self-learning and efficient operation.
The platform shall provide its services as a WeChat Mini Program and support the specified client environment of Android 5.0 or later with WeChat 8.0 or later.

components.name: WeChat Mini Program Client
components.description: Frontend client running on WeChat runtime providing product browsing, ordering, and personal center interfaces.

components.name: Admin Web Console
components.description: Web portal for administrative management of products, orders, users, and audit logs.

components.name: API Gateway & Security Filter
components.description: Performs bot detection, request rate limiting, input parameter sanitization, routing, authentication delegation, and circuit breaking.

components.name: User & Authentication Service
components.description: Manages user profiles, role-based access control (guests, customers, sellers, admins), privacy protection, and user management.

components.name: Product Catalog Service
components.description: Handles product categorization, popularity-ranked indexing, search queries, and administrative lifecycle management of items.

components.name: Order Management Service
components.description: Executes order creation, modification, state transition validation, cancellation, and order history retrieval.

components.name: Audit Logging Service
components.description: Records administrative actions and provides structured querying capabilities over management audit trails.

components.name: Distributed Cache Cluster
components.description: Caches popularity rankings, category catalogs, and frequent searches to meet high-performance latency requirements.

components.name: Relational Persistence Store
components.description: Provides secure, transactional relational data storage with parameterized query interfaces preventing SQL injection.

components.name: Observability & Telemetry System
components.description: Collects runtime metrics, APM traces, resource utilization, and structured logs across services and middleware for fault localization.
